pledge_reading.reading: The notes constitute unsecured and unsubordinated obligations of the issuer, ranking equally with each other and with the issuers other unsecured and unsubordinated obligations, except where mandatory statutory provisions accord those obligations priority.
pledge_reading.qualification: Contractual rank does not guarantee payment, equal recovery or the absence of a statutory priority. The exception does not itself identify or adjudicate any statute.

pledge_comparison_sources.quote: (1) Status. The obligations under the Notes constitute unsecured and unsubordinated
obligations of the Issuer ranking pari passu among themselves and pari passu with all
other unsecured and unsubordinated obligations of the Issuer, unless such obligations
are accorded priority under mandatory provisions of statutory law.

but only up to the time all amounts of principal and interest have been placed at the
disposal of the Fiscal Agent, not to provide security upon any of its assets for any
present or future Capital Market Indebtedness or any guarantees or other indemnities
resulting therefrom, without at the same time having the Holders share equally and
ratably in such security or such other security as shall be approved by an independent
accounting firm of internationally recognized standing as being equivalent security.
"Capital Market Indebtedness" means any obligation for the repayment of borrowed
money which is in the form of, or represented or evidenced by, bonds, notes or other
securities, with an original maturity of more than one year, which are, or are capable

source_comparison.interpretation: Selected German issuer wording controls this supplied reading. English equally and ratably is retained for comparison; no proportionality adjudication or imported guarantor obligation follows.

clauses.quote: (2) Negativverpflichtung. Die Emittentin verpflichtet sich, solange Schuldverschreibungen ausstehen, jedoch nur bis zu dem Zeitpunkt, an dem alle Beträge an Kapital und Zinsen dem Fiscal Agent zur Verfügung gestellt worden sind, keine gegenwärtigen oder zukünftigen Kapitalmarktverbindlichkeiten und keine Garantien oder andere Gewährleistungen dafür durch Grund- oder Mobiliarpfandrechte an ihrem Vermögen zu besichern, ohne jeweils die Gläubiger zur gleichen Zeit und im gleichen Rang an solchen Sicherheiten oder an solchen anderen Sicherheiten, die von einem internationalen angesehenen unabhängigen Wirtschaftsprüfer als gleichwertige Sicherheit anerkannt werden, teilnehmen zu lassen.
clauses.effect_explanation: These status, covenant and definition provisions alone confer no uncompensated principal-loss or compulsory-conversion authority. Statutory priority, remedies and actual compliance remain unevaluated.

pledge_reading.reading: While notes remain outstanding, but only until all principal and interest amounts have been placed at the disposal of the Fiscal Agent, the issuer undertakes not to secure present or future capital-market indebtedness or guarantees or other assurances for that indebtedness through Grund- oder Mobiliarpfandrechte over its assets (security rights over land or movable property) without having holders participate at the same time and with the same rank in that security or other security recognized as equivalent by an internationally recognized independent auditor.
pledge_reading.qualification: This preserves the controlling German issuer covenant, including its limited debt scope and equivalent-security alternative. Funding the Fiscal Agent is not proof of receipt by holders. It does not import the excluded guarantor wording about allowing security to subsist, a proportionality rule from another wording, or section 328 BGB enforcement rights. Actual security, compliance and remedies are not evaluated.

clauses.quote: "Kapitalmarktverbindlichkeit" bezeichnet jede Verbindlichkeit hinsichtlich der Rückzahlung aufgenommener Geldbeträge, die durch Schuldverschreibungen oder sonstige Wertpapiere mit einer ursprünglichen Laufzeit von mehr als einem Jahr, die an einer Börse oder an einem anderen anerkannten Wertpapiermarkt notiert oder gehandelt werden oder werden können, verbrieft oder verkörpert ist .
clauses.effect_explanation: These status, covenant and definition provisions alone confer no uncompensated principal-loss or compulsory-conversion authority. Statutory priority, remedies and actual compliance remain unevaluated.

pledge_reading.reading: Capital-market indebtedness means an obligation to repay borrowed money represented or evidenced by bonds or other securities with an original maturity of more than one year that are, or can be, listed or traded on a stock exchange or another recognized securities market.
pledge_reading.qualification: The definition is narrower than all borrowed money and broader than securities currently listed or traded. The original maturity, strict greater-than-one-year threshold and potential marketability are retained; no actual obligation is classified here.
